 Showers could spoil the spooky fun 
 Sunny skies stick around for the end of the week, but rain moves in for the weekend. By Chelsea Simmons Published : Oct. 28, 2026 at 7:27 PM EDT | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google ABOVE-AVERAGE TEMEPERATURES: Temperatures will remain in the upper 70s and low 80s throughout the week, exceeding the seasonal average in the low 70s. Highs could drop into the low 70s heading into the weekend due to cloud cover and rain chances.
 Rain chances are expected to increase over Halloween weekend and continue into the next work week. (WTVA) HAUNTING RAIN CHANCES: Rain chances remain minimal through most of the workweek before increasing on Friday and continuing into next week. Scattered showers and storms are possible over the weekend. While the exact timing is still being determined, rain is likely on either Saturday or Sunday. This could impact those trick or treat plans so make sure to check the radar before you head out. 
 RAIN NEXT WEEK: A second system is expected early to mid-next week, which should help relieve drought conditions some. For now though still hold off on any type of burning.
